description: This file defines the ProductOption entity class, representing product options in the catalog module of the sales management system. It includes mappings for database persistence using JPA annotations, including fields for option details, descriptions, and relationships to merchant stores.

classes.name: ProductOption
classes.description: Entity class representing a product option with attributes such as type, code, descriptions, and related merchant store. It manages database persistence and relationships with description entities.

methods.name: getProductOptionSortOrder
methods.description: Accessor for the product option's sort order.

methods.name: setProductOptionSortOrder
methods.description: Mutator for the product option's sort order.

methods.name: getProductOptionType
methods.description: Returns the type of the product option.

methods.name: setProductOptionType
methods.description: Sets the type of the product option.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the set of product option descriptions.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the descriptions for the product option.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the product option.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the product option.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with this product option.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates this product option with a merchant store.

methods.name: setDescriptionsList
methods.description: Sets the list of descriptions (for internal use).

methods.name: getDescriptionsList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of descriptions, converting from the set if necessary.

methods.name: getDescriptionsSettoList
methods.description: Returns the descriptions as a list, initializing from the set if needed.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the unique code for the product option.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code of the product option.

methods.name: setReadOnly
methods.description: Sets whether the product option is read-only.

methods.name: isReadOnly
methods.description: Checks if the product option is read-only.
